title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Calculate products of all elements except nums[i] in O(n) without division.
starterCode:
def productExceptSelf(nums):
    res = [1] * len(nums)
    prefix = 1
    for i in range(len(nums)):
        res[i] = prefix
        prefix *= nums[i]
    postfix = 1
    for i in range(len(nums) - 1, -1, -1):
        res[i] *= postfix
        postfix *= nums[i]
    return res

print("Products:", productExceptSelf([1, 2, 3, 4]))

title: Valid Sudoku
description: Verify that each row, column, and 3x3 box contains unique digits 1-9.
starterCode:
def isValidSudoku(board):
    rows = [set() for _ in range(9)]
    cols = [set() for _ in range(9)]
    boxes = [set() for _ in range(9)]
    for r in range(9):
        for c in range(9):
            val = board[r][c]
            if val == ".": continue
            box_idx = (r // 3) * 3 + (c // 3)
            if val in rows[r] or val in cols[c] or val in boxes[box_idx]:
                return False
            rows[r].add(val); cols[c].add(val); boxes[box_idx].add(val)
    return True

mini = [["5","3",".",".","7",".",".",".","."]] + [["."]*9]*8
print("Valid:", isValidSudoku(mini))

title: Majority Element
description: Find the element appearing more than n/2 times in O(1) space.
starterCode:
def majorityElement(nums):
    candidate = None
    count = 0
    for n in nums:
        if count == 0: candidate = n
        count += 1 if n == candidate else -1
    return candidate

print("Majority:", majorityElement([2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2]))

title: Single Number
description: Every element appears twice except for one. Find that single element.
starterCode:
def singleNumber(nums):
    res = 0
    for n in nums: res ^= n
    return res

print("Single:", singleNumber([4, 1, 2, 1, 2]))

title: Rotate Array
description: Rotate array to right by k steps using in-place triple reversal.
starterCode:
def rotate(nums, k):
    k = k % len(nums)
    def rev(start, end):
        while start < end:
            nums[start], nums[end] = nums[end], nums[start]
            start += 1; end -= 1
    rev(0, len(nums) - 1)
    rev(0, k - 1)
    rev(k, len(nums) - 1)
    return nums

print("Rotated:", rotate([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], 3))

title: Length of Last Word
description: Return length of the last word in a string consisting of non-space characters.
starterCode:
def lengthOfLastWord(s):
    i = len(s) - 1
    length = 0
    while i >= 0 and s[i] == " ": i -= 1
    while i >= 0 and s[i] != " ":
        length += 1; i -= 1
    return length

print("Last word len:", lengthOfLastWord("Hello World"))

title: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)
description: Design a data structure supporting insert, remove, and getRandom in O(1) time.
starterCode:
class RandomizedSet:
    def __init__(self):
        self.numMap = {}
        self.numList = []
    def insert(self, val):
        if val in self.numMap: return False
        self.numMap[val] = len(self.numList)
        self.numList.append(val)
        return True
    def remove(self, val):
        if val not in self.numMap: return False
        idx = self.numMap[val]
        last = self.numList[-1]
        self.numList[idx] = last
        self.numMap[last] = idx
        self.numList.pop()
        del self.numMap[val]
        return True

r = RandomizedSet()
r.insert(10)
print("Remove 10:", r.remove(10))
